Identified as this saint because: A plate from the Russian Menaion Reader naming 'Зиновий и Зиновия' — Zenobius and his sister Zenobia — numbered 02301, which is 30 October in the series' church-year numbering, this saint's day; Commons files it in Category:Zenobios and Zenobia. Zenobius was bishop of Aegae in Cilicia, as doxologia.ro's line says.
